15001.story: Through Oct 13, the weather station at Hilo International Airport 87 has caught 126.95 inches, 39.28 more than a usual year. August did the heavy lifting with 20.85 inches, and Aug 15 alone put 6.82 in the gauge. The longest the gauge sat empty was 5 days, Jan 25 to Jan 29.

15003.story: Through Oct 13, the weather station at Honolulu International Airport had most of its year in March, with 13.61 inches that month. The biggest single day was Mar 13 at 5.51 inches. The longest dry stretch ran 6 days, Sep 9 to Sep 14. On the days both years reported, this year is 14.25 inches more than last year.

15007.story: Through Oct 13, the volunteer rain gauge 1.9 miles west-southwest of Kapaa has caught 94.85 inches, 40.56 inches more than a usual year. March did most of the work at 15.99 inches, and the biggest single day came Mar 13 with 5.24 inches. On the days both years reported, 2026 is 31.51 inches ahead of 2025.

15009.story: Through Oct 13, the weather station at Kahului Airport has caught 30.29 inches, 19.26 more than a usual year. Most of it came in March, with 21.11 inches that month. The biggest single day was Mar 13 at 7.40 inches. That came right after the longest dry stretch, 13 days in a row with nothing in the gauge from Feb 26 to Mar 10.
